To stress the importance of top-line growth, each officer is measured against Abbott's internal targets
To stress the importance of profitability, each officer is assessed on relevant return goals, primarily earnings, margin contribution, and cash flow.

Leadership goals are primarily related to talent and succession planning initiatives.
